name: projection_lt_stack_v2
hypothesis: Stack the repeatable M128 verify pooler/unpooler plan changes with a recorded alternative M256 qkv cuBLASLt descriptor; isolate the large qkv route while retaining all other v18 dispatches.
decision_reason: Adding the M256 qkv alternative lowered aggregate to 1.516x; its verify-32 qkv kernel profile was 18.3 us vs 17.6 us prior.
